classification_rules.c1: identity_error = recorded desc names a different molecular system; state_error = recorded desc asserts a contradicted ligation/assembly state; imprecise-but-true recorded as notes only
classification_rules.c2_resolution: recorded vs official resolution_combined[0]; strict |diff|>0.005 A; tolerant |diff|>0.01 A
classification_rules.c2_method: category-implied method (xray->X-RAY DIFFRACTION, cryo_em->ELECTRON MICROSCOPY, nmr->SOLUTION NMR) vs official EXPDTL
classification_rules.c3: entity class of the ACTUAL acquired structure vs a protein-only calibration protocol
classification_rules.c4: PDB record-level parse failures; anomalies informational; measurement re-run NOT performed (hard stop)
classification_rules.c5: fresh SHA-256 of https://files.rcsb.org/download/{id}.pdb vs v24 coordinate_manifest.json SHA-256
